name: UI dependency refresh

# Weekly bundled update of all non-breaking JS dependencies in ui/:
# bumps package.json ranges up to the latest minor, refreshes the
# lockfile (including transitive deps, which Dependabot security
# updates often can't fix), and opens a single rolling PR.
#
# The PR is created with the default GITHUB_TOKEN, which does not
# trigger CI workflows — the lint/test/build steps in this job are
# the verification gate. Close and reopen the PR to force a CI run.

on:
  workflow_dispatch: {}
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 6 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  refresh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: test
          POSTGRES_USER: testuser
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: testpass
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="pg_isready -U testuser -d test" --health-interval=5s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=10
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: ui
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Bump package.json ranges to latest minor
        run: npx --yes npm-check-updates --upgrade --target minor
      - name: Update all dependencies within ranges
        run: npm update
      - name: Apply remaining non-breaking security fixes
        run: npm audit fix --audit-level=critical
      - name: Run prek hooks
        uses: j178/prek-action@v3.1.0
        with:
          working-directory: ui
      - name: Run Jest tests
        run: npm test
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v8
        with:
          branch: chore/ui-deps-refresh
          delete-branch: true
          add-paths: |
            ui/package.json
            ui/package-lock.json
          commit-message: Weekly refresh of non-breaking UI dependencies
          title: Weekly refresh of non-breaking UI dependencies
          body: |
            Automated bundle of all non-breaking dependency updates in `ui/`:
            minor and patch bumps of `package.json` ranges, a full lockfile
            refresh within those ranges (covers transitive security fixes that
            Dependabot cannot resolve), and `npm audit fix`.

            ESLint, Jest and `next build` passed against these versions in the
            workflow run that created this PR. Regular CI does not trigger on
            PRs opened by `GITHUB_TOKEN` — close and reopen the PR to force it.

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
